sections.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

texts.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称[From.GetName]上的巨大结构实际上是某种未知外星生物的庞大遗骸。这具遗骸不仅巨大到能从[primitive_planet.GetName]轨道上通过肉眼直接看到，而且它似乎还在不断大量散布某种作用于精神层面的化学物质，或许一直影响着这颗行星上有机生物的神经系统。
texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the enormous structure located on [From.GetName] is in fact the gargantuan corpse of some unidentified alien creature. Not only is the corpse large enough to be seen with the naked eye from [primitive_planet.GetName], it also appears to be shedding large quantities of psychotropic chemicals that may have neurological side effects for organic life forms on the planet.

label.zh: 在进一步调查之前抓点儿小零食好了。
label.en: Grab a snack before investigating further.

label.zh: 入侵这颗卫星所环绕的前超光速星球后（2天）
label.en: After invading the primitive planet this moon orbits (2 days)

texts.zh:
在摧毁了[dead_god_planet.GetName]上土著设置的防御阵线后，许多当地原住民的使者前来主动联络。看起来当地土著已经将那具位于该行星的卫星上的巨型生物遗骸当做死亡之神供奉很久了。他们相信终有一天神会起死回生，变成重生之神，并带给他们的人民一个新的繁荣纪元。

由于我们来自星空，拥有他们难以理解的科学技术，许多当地人开始相信我们就是死亡之神回归的先驱。
texts.en:
After overwhelming the primitive defenses mounted by the natives on [dead_god_planet.GetName], our forces were approached by a number of envoys from the inhabitants. It seems that the locals have worshiped the remains of the gargantuan creature on the planet's moon as a god of death for generations beyond their remembrance. The locals believed that one day their god would rise from the dead, transforming into a deity of rebirth and ushering in a new era of prosperity for their people.

As we came from the stars boasting technology beyond their comprehension, many of the locals seem to be convinced we are heralds of their god of death.

label.zh: 我们正好可以利用这一点。
label.en: Surely that will play to our advantage.

tooltips.zh: 每个£pop£[worshipper_species.GetAdj]人口获得240个月的信念修正，获得+33%幸福度与+25%£job£岗位产出的资源。
tooltips.en: Every £pop£ [worshipper_species.GetAdj] Pop gains the modifier Conviction for 240 months, granting +33% Happiness and +25% Resources from £job£ Jobs.

label.zh: 这太荒谬了，我们不会陪他们演戏的。
label.en: This is ridiculous. We will not play along.

label.zh: 是的，我们是被你们的神派来的，你们很快就会去陪它了。
label.en: Yes, we come from your god. You will soon join him.
Just get them off my planet!

summary.text:
# 沉默巨兽 / Silent Behemoth

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:238-281; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3494 (distar.80); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3562-3633 (distar.81-82); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:836

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。前超光速文明星球的不宜居卫星被调查时，这一异常（2级，权重 add 1000，几乎必然优先）生成，并给母星加隐藏修正 dead_god_planet_hidden。

Requires Distant Stars. When an uninhabitable moon of a primitive civilisation's planet is surveyed, this level-2 anomaly (add 1000, practically always chosen) spawns and gives the primitive planet the hidden modifier dead_god_planet_hidden.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.80“沉默巨兽”：卫星上的巨大结构其实是一头未知巨型生物的尸体，从原住民星球肉眼可见，并散发精神性化学物质。结果：社会学矿藏、社会学研究奖励，原住民星球改为 dead_god_planet 修正。
2. 若之后以地面入侵击败该星球的前超光速守军，隐藏事件 distar.81 在2天后触发 distar.82“死亡之神”：原住民把尸体奉为死亡之神，并把入侵者视为神的使者。

1. distar.80 "Silent Behemoth": the huge formation is the corpse of an unknown gargantuan creature, visible from the natives' world and shedding psychotropic chemicals. Results: a society deposit, a society research reward, and the native planet gets dead_god_planet.
2. If the primitive planet is later invaded and its defenders beaten, the hidden distar.81 fires distar.82 "God of Death" two days later: the natives worship the corpse as a god of death and see the invaders as its heralds.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.82：a 利用信仰（崇拜者物种的人口获得240个月“信念”修正，并记录标本）；b 拒绝配合；c 需吞噬虫群或允许净化；d 需仅允许驱逐。

distar.82: a exploit the belief (worshipper pops get Conviction for 240 months; a specimen is recorded); b refuse; c requires Devouring Swarm or purge allowed; d requires displacement-only purge policy.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.80 另有“演化猎手”起源专属选项（获取局势进度与DNA）。入侵后事件不要求先调查异常，因为生成异常时已放置隐藏修正。

distar.80 has an extra Evolutionary Predators origin option (situation progress and DNA). The invasion event does not require the anomaly to be researched, because the hidden modifier is placed on spawn.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义（含 on_spawn）、distar.80–82 与 on_colony_attackers_win。修正：草稿把 distar.82 作为独立故事；现以审阅连接接在异常结果之后。

Checked the anomaly (incl. on_spawn), distar.80–82 and on_colony_attackers_win. Correction: distar.82 was a separate story in the draft; it now follows the anomaly result via a reviewed link.
